stars.notes: Points out of 100 per place type. Items marked not applicable by the owner are removed and the score is normalised to 100 from the remaining items. Confirmed 'Not true' reports remove that item's points. Only visitor-checkable practices count for stars.

eco_shop.label: Eco shop
eco_shop.notes: Map entry only. Purchases verified by receipt scan: GPS within ~100 m of registered location, shop name on receipt matches, receipt dated today, receipt fingerprint (shop + receipt no. + date/time + total) blocks reuse. AI extracts line items and calculates CO2/plastic saved; unreadable receipts give a stamp without impact.
